_doc: Every fight in place (design/ruins/content.md). R1 has the night patrol in the College ruins; R2 adds the halls. waves run one after another (the next starts when the yard is clear); with survive > 0 they arrive on a timer instead and the fight is won by lasting that many seconds. lethal: losing ends the loop. unkillable: kinds that are knocked down (for down_time seconds) instead of dying. hits: a duel won by the first to land that many hits of at least hit_min damage; trickle: in a survive fight, one more Hollow every that many seconds; tell: the rival always opens with his lance, and stands for lance_recover seconds after each one. leash: in the town, how far (sim px) the mist lets you stray from where the fight began (220 unless given). max_alive: the trickle waits while that many enemies are up. light_shy: false means the Hollows ignore lamplight (the tide is too many for it); otherwise they won't step into a lit lamp's pool. In the halls a group can come out of a named crack ("crack": it glows for glow seconds, 1 unless the encounter gives one, then its embers burst out one after another), wait "at" seconds into its wave, and give its units "flags". flooded_by: the once-a-day action (the sluice) that starts the guardian quenched; a "guardian" group is the one it floods. waived: the waves used once you know that trial (the Warden comes straight to its second phase). toll (N-6.3): the brigands' bridge toll (enemy spec §13.1, places spec F13); it has no place yet (the east road comes with N-7.1.5), so for now it is fought only by the fight tests, in the camp yard. Losing to people isn't lethal (you wake injured). lamp_night (N-6.3): the new Hollows (Lantern-eater and Choir, then an Overdrawn Husk); like the toll it waits for its place (the lamp depot, Sunken Square and glassworks, N-7.1).
